requirements.requirement_text: Quotes are due by October 15, 2026 at 2:00 PM Eastern.
requirements.supporting_quote: Quotes are due no later than October 15, 2026 2:00 PM ET.

requirements.requirement_text: Submit the quote by email to the contracting officer.
requirements.supporting_quote: Quotes shall be submitted by email to jane.buyer@dla.mil.

requirements.requirement_text: Complete and sign the SF 1449 and return it with the quote.
requirements.supporting_quote: Quoters shall complete and sign the SF 1449 and return it with the quote.

requirements.requirement_text: Submit all files in PDF format.
requirements.supporting_quote: All files shall be submitted in PDF format.

requirements.requirement_text: Price every CLIN; quotes missing CLIN pricing are rejected.
requirements.supporting_quote: Quotes that do not include pricing for every CLIN will be rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: Provide three past performance references for similar supply contracts.
requirements.supporting_quote: Quoters shall provide three past performance references for similar supply contracts.

requirements.requirement_text: Offeror must be registered in SAM when the quote is submitted.
requirements.supporting_quote: Offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time of quote submission.

requirements.requirement_text: Quoter must be a small business under NAICS 339113 (total small business set-aside).
requirements.supporting_quote: This acquisition is a total small business set-aside; the quoter must be a small business under NAICS 339113.

requirements.requirement_text: Deliver within 30 calendar days after award, FOB Destination.
requirements.supporting_quote: Delivery shall be made within 30 calendar days after award, FOB Destination.

requirements.requirement_text: Enter a unit price on the price schedule for each CLIN.
requirements.supporting_quote: Every CLIN on the schedule requires a unit price entry.
